name: OcMesher
aliases: OcMesher Octree Construction and Mesh Extraction
definition: A method to extract a memory-efficient, highly detailed mesh for an unbounded scene represented by signed distance functions (SDFs), using a view-dependent octree structure based on a given set of camera views.
summary: OcMesher extracts memory-efficient triangle meshes from SDFs using a view-dependent octree that prioritizes resolution based on projected pixel density rather than surface flatness.
